## Summary

Describe the documentation or platform-contract change.

## Production evidence

- [ ] Claims are verified against production behavior/source or an approved public contract.
- [ ] No internal-only endpoints, secrets, infrastructure details, or roadmap-only capabilities are published.

## Quality gates

- [ ] Human page and Markdown twin are synchronized where applicable.
- [ ] Navigation/search/sitemap implications were reviewed.
- [ ] Accessibility and responsive behavior were considered.
- [ ] `Docs CI` passes.
- [ ] Changelog/deprecation guidance was updated when required.
